## Qualification

Independently qualify the exact revision and state being considered for publication.

## Disclosure and publication

Public synchronization is disclosure before any immutable release; it requires a separate authorized scope. Publication produces a verifiable bundle and immutable release without changing the v9 Logical Commitment.

## Activation

Activation is optional and separate. Publishing a release does not automatically change the active channel.
